name: Northeast Solar
old_description: Electric rates are unpredictable. Power disruptions are increasing. Utility companies still decide what you pay.
about:
Northeast Solar is a residential energy services company based in Hatfield, Massachusetts, founded in 2015. The company serves homeowners across four counties in Western Massachusetts, offering integrated energy systems that combine solar generation, battery storage, heat-pump mini-splits, and electric-vehicle charging. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The firm designs and installs complete home energy systems rather than selling standalone equipment. Its "Power Plan" assessment evaluates a home's current energy use, roof potential, and owner goals to specify a tailored mix of solar photovoltaics, Enphase microinverter-based storage, Mitsubishi Electric mini-splits, and EV chargers. All installation work is performed by Northeast Solar's own licensed employees; the company does not use subcontractors. Since inception it has completed more than 2,000 installations.

The customer base consists exclusively of residential property owners in Western Massachusetts seeking to replace variable utility bills with fixed-cost energy, improve resilience during grid outages, and reduce heating and cooling expenses. Typical projects include solar leases with zero down payment and a 25-year fixed rate, mini-split retrofits that qualify for Mass Save rebates up to $8,500, and battery systems that provide backup power.

Northeast Solar differentiates itself by maintaining a single, directly employed crew across all trades, a 10-year workmanship warranty, and certifications including A+ Better Business Bureau rating (since 2015), Enphase Gold Installer status, Mitsubishi Diamond Installer status, and Mass Save Certified Heat Pump Installer designation. The company emphasizes long-term local support over rapid growth.
